method: DIFFERENT FROM AUTHOR: (1) Enumerate ambient dependency attack surface a core could use without CoreDeps (env, fs, signals, thread-locals, provider globals) and check each is either in CoreDeps or forbidden by a test. (2) Ask whether LN-06 can pass while the core still branches on store warmth via side channel. (3) Compare LN-09 text to sealed storage protocol in 03/06 without re-reading author's resolves map first.
whatCouldHaveFailed: CoreDeps missing cancellation, snapshot VFS, toolchain identity, or logger that affects control flow
LN-06 allowing core to read store.stats().warmth
LN-09 requiring an external mutex coordinator
Tests that require a resident host while claiming not to

resolves.A2-R1-01: ACCEPT — LN-04 negative property of core is the right shape
resolves.A2-R1-02: ACCEPT — no resident required for suite
resolves.A2-R1-03: ACCEPT — LN-09 same-project contention is necessary
resolves.A2-R1-05: ACCEPT — removing cachePolicy from core is correct
resolves.A2-R1-06: CONDITIONAL — exhaustiveForV1_1 claim needs gap analysis

attackSurfaceCheck.status: not in CoreDeps; must be only via provider grants inside registry
attackSurfaceCheck.note: Add explicit non-goal: core has no net handle

attackSurfaceCheck.detail: If any producer needs randomness for non-digest ids, it must not be ambient. Either forbid rng in core analysis path or add rng: DeterministicOrInjected to CoreDeps.

attackSurfaceCheck.note: If structured diagnostics differ from progress, name it or fold into progressSink

attackSurfaceCheck.detail: Plan may embed rule set, but loading pack implementations needs a registry handle. If it is inside providerRegistry, say so. If not, CoreDeps is not exhaustive and LN-02 is vacuous.

coreDepsExhaustiveness.verdict: Not proven exhaustive. Two named gaps (rng; rule-pack load surface). exhaustiveForV1_1 should be false until closed or explicitly out-of-scope with LN-02 extended.

ln06WarmStore.detail: Populated vs empty StoreHandle is the right substitute for cold|warm. Strengthen: core must not observe store implementation type or warmth metrics; only FactView/CAS APIs. Add assertion that storeHandle.warmth (if any) is not readable from core package.

ln09StorageProtocol.detail: Busy-timeout, idempotent insert, write-then-link match 03/06. Explicitly rejects external coordinator — correct. Does not prove WAL-on-network-fs detection; out of scope for LN suite.

sealR1Item1.blocker: Close A1-R1-DEPS-01/02 or document as explicit non-deps with LN-02 extension; then seal R-1(1) as CANDIDATE→SEALED after green conformance implementation exists

knownLimitations: Review is of the spec, not a running suite.
